title: Host genetics highlights IFN-gamma-dependent Toxoplasma genes encoding secreted and non-secreted virulence factors in in vivo CRISPR screens
paper_method: Per-gene fitness scores, WT-vs-KO and P4-vs-WT t-tests
model: Toxoplasma RH tachyzoites, metabolism sublibrary (361 genes, 3,610 gRNAs), in vivo mouse passage
contrast: WT vs Ifngr1-/- mouse passage (8 vs 7); also in vitro (P4) vs WT (1 vs 8)
paper_calls: Table S3A: WT-vs-KO and P4-vs-WT per-gene fitness; ROP18 the shared IFN-gamma control
barcs_calls: WT vs KO: 14 genes at FDR 0.10 (10 depleted in WT); P4 vs WT: 193
named_hits: ROP18 #1 (FDR 6e-9); GRA12/GRA45 are not in this sublibrary
verdict: BARCS ranks the shared positive control ROP18 first and tracks the paper's WT-vs-KO ranking closely (Spearman 0.64, top-25 overlap 17/25); the small WT-vs-KO hit list reflects the metabolism sublibrary's few strong IFN-gamma-dependent genes.
